objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, revised, invalidated or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document type or document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed or maintained for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for areas of validity.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type or level used to differentiate and structure documents and define templates or validity settings.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating a new document.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user or person participating in authorizations, workflows, distribution, acknowledgement or requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization, reader access, author selection, reviewer selection, releaser selection, distribution or archive access.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User who can view approved objects and dependent objects and can take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person maintained as author of a document who signs creation in the first workflow step and can create change proposals.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned personal change rights on a document without relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects in review workflow steps.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for the document and content who decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information added to a document and released or published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant equipment or archived dependent object mentioned as added to or reactivated with a document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, managed in the document cockpit and linked to the document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, acknowledgement, translation approval or reactivation workflows.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow status, requests, releases, distribution, acknowledgements or change proposal handling.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard populated based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which visibility of a document can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent translated version of a released document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attachment of a new information object with selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and document properties.

evts.name: maintain_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web or display document details in dashboards.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically or manually link documents with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents or master data.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information attached to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment associated with a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an Attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes the release step to release the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Workflow participant rejects during review or release, canceling subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or changed.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change Proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change Proposals directly in the Change Proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process and delete request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for AKS or Override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process a request for Override with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: Process the reactivation workflow step by the request creator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents and create a new version retaining metadata and properties.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request assigned persons and user group users by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of the released document version.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_overview
evts.description: Notify author team of unconfirmed acknowledgements and when all confirmations are complete.

evts.name: populate_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Check and release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition and reference the original document.
